provenance_note: Initial annotations produced by the approved Phase 12D/12E AI pipeline (Pass 1, Kaggle T4), then audited and corrected by Pass 2 and Pass 3 AI audits. This dataset is NOT human-verified ground truth; see README.md for measured residual error rates. Post-annotation Stages B-D (second independent audit, Stage C correction layer, third/final audit) and the Stage E freeze incorporate 17 further Stage C correction rows into this release (dual_camera_gt_v1.0_ai_assisted_audited): one additional false-positive track exclusion (pair_020 back_moto_0003), three constant helmet states and two uncertain-markings on pair_004 orphan tracks, plus the rider-frame validity layer (rider_frame_validity.csv). See RELEASE_NOTES.md.

release.base: data/dual_camera_test_v1/annotations/ (Mission-1 corrected view, 69 ops) + Stage C layer (17 rows, work/stageC/)
